verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the above-the-fold hero location and its visible content hierarchy, a concrete frontend layout behavior.
The client changes the hero's visual emphasis and requires the book cover to be integrated with the headline, directly affecting UI composition.
Target-specific implementation claim: the immediately preceding request explicitly enumerates hero presentation changes, and the freelancer claims all enumerated changes complete.

The client restores the earlier hero composition, constrains visual density and control overlap, and supersedes the prior mandatory hero-level book-cover integration; the removed key exists in prior state.
First concrete failure after the completion claim: oversized text cluttered the hero and its image overlapped the dashboard control.
First post-failure verification: the client says the landing page looks good and identifies only the separate book-cover cropping issue as remaining.
